_note: After 'Because of that, {first} '. Frames. Templates. {UPPERCASE} slots draw a fresh atom each time; {lowercase} slots are the story's own fields ({first}, {place}, {want}...). {the_thing}, {the_someone}, {the_message}, {the_disaster} reuse something an earlier beat introduced: favored when it exists, never used when it doesn't. Tagged entries are favored in those genres. {SLOT:feature} requires a feature (see frames.py); verbs bind to the subject and object around them; {was}/{is} agree with the noun before.
